topic: Session logic and facility type handling
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the complexity of session logic, specifically addressing double negative logical conditions. A specific code snippet was analyzed: `if (!(!dto.isConnected() && dto.getOwnerType() == OwnerType.facility))` which was shown to be logically equivalent to `if (dto.isConnected() || dto.getOwnerType() != OwnerType.facility)`. The conversation also touched upon data handling issues, noting that on the entire 'Afa' part of facilities, the type is skipped in 'R' while type 'F' works correctly. It was noted that this issue is not limited to Lithuania.

[me] stated they were currently working on a more prioritized task.
